title_zh: 一签｜文字盲盒与像素签名
title_en: One Fortune | Notes to Draw and Keep
description_zh:
一签是一只随身文字盲盒。按下抽签，拆开一封未知的信：可能是一首古诗、一句冷幽默、一个荒诞脑洞，也可能是生活观察或一点安慰。喜欢哪一句，就留在像素卡片上，作为自己的个人签名展示。

内置2,200张完整签文：1,980条原创短句与220条古诗词摘句，诗词显示作者和篇名。默认从全库随机抽取；想专门读某类内容，可在独立主题页选好并确认。同一轮不重复，回首页或重启恢复全库随机。安慰占签库20%、诗词占10%，其余带来更多关于日常、关系、审美与出走的不同说法。

封好的信轻轻晃动、拆开、揭晓，短小的音乐盒音效陪着这份期待；音量可调，也能静音。十个像素系列提供320款皮肤、1,920种外观，随机换风景，文字保持原样。再抽不会替换已留签名，重启继续展示。完全离线，无需配网或付费。签文用于阅读、表达和娱乐，不作未来预测。

封面为玩法示意；四张详情图为实际程序主机渲染与说明，非设备实拍。
description_en:
One Fortune is a pocket surprise box of words. Press to draw and open an unknown letter: a classical verse, a dry joke, a surreal idea, an everyday observation or a little reassurance. Keep a line you like on a pixel-art card as your personal signature.

Discover 2,200 complete notes: 1,980 original lines and 220 classical Chinese poetry excerpts with author and work title. Draw randomly across the whole collection by default, or confirm one of eight themes on a separate selector. Notes do not repeat within a cycle. Returning home or restarting restores whole-bank draws. Reassurance makes up 20% of the collection and poetry 10%; the rest brings different perspectives on daily life, relationships, taste and small outings.

A sealed letter shakes, opens and reveals its words, accompanied by brief music-box sounds. Adjust the volume or mute them. Ten pixel-art collections offer 320 skins and 1,920 appearances to discover in shuffled order. Change the scenery while keeping the words. Drawing again keeps your saved signature, and restarting displays it again. Fully offline, with no Wi-Fi setup or payment. The interface and notes are Chinese, intended for reading, expression and entertainment rather than predictions.

The cover is a gameplay illustration. Four detail images use actual application host renders and explanatory graphics, not device photographs.
instructions_zh:
1. 开机即可使用，完全离线，无需配网；黑屏先按任意键唤醒。若显示已留签名，长按确定回首页。
2. 首页按确定，从全库随机抽取。等信封揭晓；拆信时按确定可跳过。
3. 想按主题抽取：首页按上／下进入主题页，上下选择、确定后抽签。长按确定返回全库随机；重启也恢复全库。
4. 结果页按上再抽、下随机换肤、确定留作签名。再抽保留原签名。长按确定回首页，首页长按确定查看签名。
5. 卡片长按上调音量，上下调节、确定保存；长按确定取消。长按下开关音效。签名、已读与声音设置重启保留。
instructions_en:
1. Turn on the device; it works offline with no Wi-Fi setup. Press any button once to wake a dark display. If your saved signature is shown, hold OK to return home.
2. Press OK on home to draw randomly from the whole collection. Wait for the letter to reveal its words, or press OK during opening to skip.
3. For a specific theme, press UP/DOWN on home to open the selector. Browse with UP/DOWN and press OK to confirm and draw. Hold OK to return to whole-bank draws; restarting restores them too.
4. On the result, press UP to draw again, DOWN for random artwork, or OK to keep the signature. Drawing preserves your old signature. Hold OK to return home; hold OK on home to view your saved card.
5. On a card, hold UP for volume, adjust with UP/DOWN and press OK to save; hold OK to cancel. Hold DOWN to toggle sound. Your signature, read history and sound settings survive restarts.
changelog_zh:
• 默认从整个签库随机抽取，不再被之前保存的主题限制。回首页或重启恢复全库随机，已读记录和已留签名继续保留。
• 新增独立主题选择页，放大主题文字，按确定后才生效；卡片顶部显示当前抽取范围，避免误以为正在混抽。
• 全库内容一起洗牌，取消每20张固定安排两首诗的规则。诗词仍占完整签库10%，短期抽取可能没有诗，也可能遇到多首。
changelog_en:
• Draws randomly from the whole collection by default, without restrictions from a previously saved theme. Returning home or restarting restores whole-bank draws while keeping read history and saved signatures.
• Adds a separate selector with larger theme text. A theme takes effect only after OK confirms it, and the card header shows the current draw scope.
• Shuffles all notes together and removes the rule placing exactly two poems in each 20-card block. Poetry still makes up 10% of the bank; a short run may contain no poems or several.
